mapper.insert: INSERT INTO multiple_choice_problems ( problem_id, question, choice_1_content, choice_2_content, choice_3_content, choice_4_content, answer_number ) VALUES ( #{problemId}, #{question}, #{choice1Content}, #{choice2Content}, #{choice3Content}, #{choice4Content}, #{answerNumber} );
mapper.select: SELECT p.problem_id AS `problemId`, p.cert_id AS `certId`, c.name AS `certificationName`, p.problem_type AS `problemType`, p.problem_title AS `problemTitle`, m.question AS `question`, m.choice_1_content AS `choice1Content`, m.choice_2_content AS `choice2Content`, m.choice_3_content AS `choice3Content`, m.choice_4_content AS `choice4Content`, m.answer_number AS `answerNumber` FROM problems p JOIN certifications c ON p.cert_id = c.cert_id JOIN multiple_choice_problems m ON p.problem_id = m.problem_id WHERE p.problem_id = #{problemId};

SELECT p.problem_id AS `problemId`, p.cert_id AS `certId`, c.name AS `certificationName`, p.problem_type AS `problemType`, p.problem_title AS `problemTitle`, s.question AS `question`, s.answer AS `answer` FROM problems p JOIN certifications c ON p.cert_id = c.cert_id JOIN short_answer_problems s ON p.problem_id = s.problem_id WHERE p.problem_id = #{problemId};

SELECT c.cert_id AS `certId`, p.problem_id AS `problemId`, p.problem_type AS `problemType`, p.problem_title AS `problemTitle` FROM certifications c JOIN problems p ON c.cert_id = p.cert_id ORDER BY created_at DESC, problem_id DESC LIMIT #{limit};
